purpose: Real-user-style health questions for comparing AskRigor before and after the instruction-optimization refactor. There is no answer key: AskRigor's job is to find better answers than the mainstream one, so runs are compared side by side by blinded judges.
style: Short, casual questions as a real person would type them. No point-by-point test specifications, no rubric text, no private details.
splitRule: DEVELOPMENT questions may be run at any time and may influence changes. HELD_OUT questions are run only in the final before/after comparison, after the refactor is frozen; their outputs may not influence any change.
